story.zh: 荆州初定根基未稳，刘备军决意征伐荆南四郡，以拓展疆土、稳固势力，一场席卷南部的征战即将拉开帷幕。
story.en: Though Jing Province has newly settled, its foundations remain precarious. Liu Bei's forces resolve to conquer the Four Commanderies of South Jing to expand their territory and consolidate their faction, heralding a campaign that will sweep across the south.

trigger.zh: 江陵属刘备，零陵属刘度，桂阳属赵范，武陵属金旋，长沙属韩玄；诸葛亮、赵云、关羽、张飞、邢道荣、黄忠、魏延存活且属正确势力；马良、存活且属刘备势力或在野
trigger.en: Jiangling belongs to Liu Bei, Lingling belongs to Liu Du, Guiyang belongs to Zhao Fan, Wuling belongs to Jin Xuan, Changsha belongs to Han Xuan, Zhuge Liang, Zhao Yun, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Xing Daorong, Huang Zhong, and Wei Yan are alive and belong to the correct factions, Ma Liang is alive and belongs to Liu Bei's faction or is Free

forbidden.zh: 主角为马良、马谡、刘琦、刘度、邢道荣、刘贤、赵范、陈应、鲍隆、樊氏、金旋、巩志、韩玄、黄忠、魏延、刘磐时无法触发剧情
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Ma Liang, Ma Su, Liu Qi, Liu Du, Xing Daorong, Liu Xian, Zhao Fan, Chen Ying, Bao Long, Lady Fan, Jin Xuan, Gong Zhi, Han Xuan, Huang Zhong, Wei Yan, or Liu Pan

defy.zh: 【<不为关羽>救下邢道荣并收为家将】，【<不为刘备、诸葛亮、关羽、张飞>救下陈应、鲍隆并收为家将】，【<不为刘备、诸葛亮、关羽、张飞、赵云>迎娶樊氏】，【<不为刘备、诸葛亮、关羽、赵云>救下金旋并收为家将】，【<不为刘备、诸葛亮、张飞、赵云>救下韩玄并收为家将】
defy.en: 【<Not Guan Yu> Rescue Xing Daorong and recruit as Retainer】, 【<Not Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang, Guan Yu, or Zhang Fei> Rescue Chen Ying and Bao Long and recruit as Retainers】, 【<Not Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, or Zhao Yun> Marry Lady Fan】, 【<Not Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang, Guan Yu, or Zhao Yun> Rescue Jin Xuan and recruit as Retainer】, 【<Not Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang, Zhang Fei, or Zhao Yun> Rescue Han Xuan and recruit as Retainer】
